scripts.build:web:compat: npm run build:web:legacy && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=process.cwd();const distDir=path.join(root,'v5-svelte-migration','dist');const distAssetsDir=path.join(distDir,'assets');const publicDir=path.join(root,'public');const publicAssetsDir=path.join(publicDir,'assets');const distIndex=path.join(distDir,'index.html');const rootIndex=path.join(root,'index.html');const publicIndex=path.join(publicDir,'index.html');fs.mkdirSync(publicDir,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(distIndex,rootIndex);fs.copyFileSync(distIndex,publicIndex);fs.rmSync(publicAssetsDir,{recursive:true,force:true});const symlinkTarget=path.relative(publicDir,distAssetsDir)||'.';fs.symlinkSync(symlinkTarget,publicAssetsDir,'dir');console.log('Prepared compatibility shell from v5-svelte-migration/dist');"
